text:
alex: Quick design fyi — noticed the new dashboard cards feel visually dense when the panel is collapsed. snapshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/card-compact.png
marie-k: yeah I saw that on staging, spacing tokens look like they were tightened in the last PR. which token was changed?
samir: I touched the list row token for perf reasons — switched --space-row from 10px -> 6px to fit more items. maybe too aggressive.
lee: 6px is pretty tight, causes hit-target regressions on touch. +1 to revert unless there's a strong perf win. :point_up:
zoe: Accessibility flag — when rows are denser the focus ring overlaps the divider. keyboard users report visual flicker. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/focus-overlap.png
alex: hmm ok. could we do a compromise: keep row height but increase inner touch padding for hitbox? i.e. visual density stays but interactive target size preserved.
marie-k: that would mean separate visual token and interaction token. e.g. `--space-row-visual` vs `--space-row-hit` — feels messy but doable. thoughts?
samir: technically doable. runtime we can pad button hit areas with ::before to avoid layout shift. but that doesn't fix focus ring overlap since that's on the row container.
lee: can we instead restore `--space-row` to 10px and reduce the card body vertical padding `--space-card-body` by 2px? keeps card footprint but fixes hit target.
zoe: that sounds cleaner and less surface area to change. Also propose we adjust focus outline offset: `outline-offset: 2px;` to avoid touching divider.
alex: agreed on outline-offset tweak. For the tokens: marie-k can you propose a delta we can ship in hotfix? small change, minimal churn.
marie-k: will do. patch plan: restore `--space-row` -> 10px, reduce `--space-card-body` 12px -> 10px, and add `outline-offset: 2px` to `.card-row:focus`. I'll post a diff.
samir: one more thing — toast timing: noticed success toasts on save now linger 5s, feels long when multiple saves. suggestion: 3s default, 6s for network errors with retry.
zoe: yes, long toast + dense UI = visual clutter. +1 to shorten success to 3s. keep error sticky.
lee: copy nit while we're here — CTA on card preview reads "Open" but context suggests "Open details". longer but clearer for screen readers.
alex: good catch. prefer explicit copy. marie-k, include that in patch?
marie-k: yup will include copy change and small a11y note on the PR.
designbot: Reminder: Design review checklist — update tokens.md and component-changelog.md when making spacing or focus changes.
alex: perfect. target: hotfix branch today, QA tomorrow. thanks team! :tada:
